readme.markdown:
# BotFactory MCP Farm

Hosted MCP servers on [MCPize](https://mcpize.com) — zero-auth public APIs, freemium x402 (USDC on Base).

## Catalog

See [CATALOG.md](./CATALOG.md) for the full list with gateway URLs.

## Connect

```
https://<slug>.mcpize.run/mcp
```

Requires an x402-capable MCP client for paid tools. `health_check` and discovery tools are free.

## Awesome list entries

See [AWESOME_ENTRIES.md](./AWESOME_ENTRIES.md).

toolsPreview.name: fetch_url_content
toolsPreview.description:
Fetch and extract clean text content from a public URL.
    Returns: {title, text, url, word_count}

toolsPreview.name: extract_article
toolsPreview.description:
Extract main article content from a news/blog URL.
    Returns: {title, description, body, author, date}

toolsPreview.name: get_page_links
toolsPreview.description:
Extract all links from a page.
    Returns: {links: [href], internal_count, external_count}

toolsPreview.name: get_page_metadata
toolsPreview.description:
Get metadata from a page: title, description, og tags, keywords.
    Returns: {title, description, keywords, og_title, og_image, og_type}
